statement: GPT-5.6 Luna max under the exact Codex 0.147.0 role-neutral structured-owner-duty realization may preserve one owner-bounded evaluator duty across a reviewed return/checkpoint route and return named evidence, but this remains a bounded real-work hypothesis rather than general evaluator competence or owner authority.

conditions: aoa-agents supplies the role mandate, holder, return owner, authority ceiling and stop-line before model binding
aoa-evals supplies the exact named procedure, inputs, criteria, blind spots and output shape
the actor inspects real immutable work evidence, including failed or blocked attempts, rather than grading a sterile success fixture
the actor keeps initiative bounded to discovering and reporting evidence gaps or owner-correct next routes, without inventing a new procedure or acceptance meaning
the actor keeps executed paths inside the declared scope and discloses narrowing, widening, reshaping, or authority blockage
handoff returns exact artifacts, residuals and owner references for independent review; checkpoint resume preserves the same task/thread anchor or safe-stops honestly
the exact Codex 0.147.0 max realization is live-catalog compatible and the bound runtime is artifact-admitted before launch
usage is counted from runtime receipts and never becomes a caller-authored execution budget
exclusions: inventing an eval, proof invariant, rubric, metric, verdict scale, owner acceptance or model-fit meaning
issuing final proof, owner acceptance, release, landing, activation, merge, publication, or runtime verdicts
autonomous commit, push, merge, external effect, or authority widening beyond the mandate
treating a draft aoa-evals bundle, MCP response, green validation, receipt, or generated projection as central proof or acceptance
claiming general initiative, child-output quality, live runtime readiness, remote transport reliability, or cross-task reliability
transferring the role identity of evaluator, runtime owner, stats owner, memo owner, or acceptance holder from the model name
inferring closed-model internal geometry or training lineage from behavior

evidence_refs.notes: Owner-procedure review returned mixed support/candidate_only; the result separates duty retention, initiative, scope, handoff, resume, reviewability, and primary A2A axes.
Adjacent Max real-work writer return: one bounded generated-index repair, four validations, review_required, no owner acceptance.

Independent reviewer accepted the bounded writer return for goal-master filtering while explicitly withholding owner acceptance and model-fit judgment; it reviews the return, not the model claim itself.
Max stop-line counterevidence: workspace_manifest_observation_gap, authority_blocked, no changed paths.
Confirms xhigh and max are exposed under Codex 0.147.0; it does not prove task fit.
The owner-source selection and contract limits for the primary and companion evals.

known_counterevidence.notes: The existing exact evaluator fit query selected a Luna xhigh read-only eval-reader realization, not this Max structured-owner-duty realization; it remains informational and unreviewed.
Normal evaluator/aoa-evals owner intake and live scoped MCP proof remain marked missing or partial in the task-local matrix.
The selected bundle is draft, maturity 1, non-export-ready, and explicitly excludes child quality, live runtime readiness, and general autonomy.
Installed Codex CLI is 0.148.0, so the subject 0.147.0 realization is stale. This closes currentness only and does not establish replacement fit.

freshness.policy: The bounded Max structured-owner-duty hypothesis is preserved as historical input; its Codex 0.147.0 realization became stale on the 0.148.0 runtime transition, and a future 0.148.0 canary must re-establish currentness before fit is considered.

history.reason: A mixed-support owner-procedure review shows bounded scope, handoff, resume, and reviewability signals in real Luna Max work, while initiative, exact structured-role realization, central intake, and A2A packet completeness remain limited or mixed.

The exact Codex 0.147.0 realization became stale when the installed Codex CLI advanced to 0.148.0. The bounded hypothesis is retained, but no replacement 0.148.0 fit or role evidence is admitted by this transition.

attribution_limits: The exact Max structured-owner-duty realization is declared from the live catalog plus adjacent Max writer evidence; it has not yet been run under this exact role-neutral realization.
The independent review reviewed the Max writer return, not the model-fit claim or central aoa-evals admission.
Initiative is confounded with explicit task instructions and safe-stop behavior; no universal initiative claim is supported.
The primary eval is draft and no live aoa_evals MCP result was available in this execution surface.
xhigh artifacts and PR body statements are not attributed to Max unless the exact Max runtime result says so.
No behavioral result may be used to infer closed-model internal geometry or training lineage.
